description: This file contains the implementation of the DittoProtocolSub interface, managing subscriptions, acknowledgements, and subscriber removal for a pub/sub system within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles streaming types, topics, and actor references, utilizing Akka actors and CompletableFutures.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSubImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DittoProtocolSub interface, managing pub/sub subscriptions, acknowledgements, and subscriber removal within the Eclipse Ditto system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DittoProtocolSubImpl using the provided ActorContext, initializing pub/sub channels.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an ActorRef to specified streaming types and topics, filtering based on streaming type.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from both live signal and twin event subscriptions.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates subscriptions for live signals based on streaming types and topics.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Unsubscribes a twin event subscriber from specified topics.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels for a subscriber, ensuring labels are fully resolved before declaration.

methods.name: ensureAcknowledgementLabelsAreFullyResolved
methods.description: Checks that all acknowledgement labels are fully resolved, throws an exception if not.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: partitionByStreamingTypes
methods.description: Partitions streaming types into live signals and twin events, executing corresponding functions.

methods.name: toFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate to filter topics based on streaming types.
